user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features
user_agents.scope: Crawl websites for search indexing; sites opted out will not appear in ChatGPT search answers

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT
user_agents.scope: Only visits pages submitted as ads; validates compliance with ad policies

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training generative AI foundation models
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for training data; disallow indicates content should not be used for model training

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform user-triggered actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs
user_agents.scope: User-initiated fetches for live responses; not automatic web crawling; robots.txt rules may not apply
user_agents.opt_out: robots.txt rules may not apply; use OAI-SearchBot for managing automatic crawl opt-outs

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collect web content for AI model training and development
user_agents.scope: General web crawl to enhance utility and safety of generative AI models
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: ClaudeBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt; supports Crawl-delay extension

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Support user-initiated web access when Claude AI users ask questions
user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetch for live responses to user queries and web search
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Claude-User / Disallow: / in robots.txt to block user-initiated content retrieval

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search result quality by analyzing online content for relevance and accuracy
user_agents.scope: Web crawl to index content for search optimization and enhance search response quality
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Claude-SearchBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt to prevent search indexing
